# Full Lifecycle Prompt

Use this prompt for a new application or major feature.

## Suggested usage

"Create a new offline business management application for a small service center."

## Expected behavior

- run the requirements analyst
- run the solution architect
- run the UI/UX designer
- run the database engineer
- coordinate backend and frontend work
- run the test engineer
- run security and code review
- package only after quality gates pass
